shadowai-r1.title: PII submitted to known unsanctioned GenAI domain

shadowai-r2.title: Strong-identifier PII to known unsanctioned GenAI domain

shadowai-r3.title: PII to any non-sanctioned endpoint with a GenAI API path
shadowai-r3.query: (url.path:(*\/conversation* OR *\/chat* OR *\/completions* OR *\/api\/generate* OR *\/api\/ask*)) AND pii.strong_count:>=1 AND (NOT domain_category:"Corporate AI")

shadowai-r4.title: Multiple PII types to non-sanctioned GenAI-path endpoint
shadowai-r4.query: (url.path:(*\/conversation* OR *\/chat* OR *\/completions* OR *\/api\/generate* OR *\/api\/ask*)) AND pii.types_distinct:>=2 AND (NOT domain_category:"Corporate AI")
